verses.text: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth’s sake.

verses.text: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?

verses.text: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
